justification: Both depict standing human-form figures shown in profile with one arm raised and an object held in the hand, wearing elaborate headgear, on a tall rectangular panel accompanied by dense inscribed signs. But A shows a multi-figure adoration scene beneath a rayed disc above many horizontal registers of text, while B shows a single large bird-headed winged figure with a bucket-like handled vessel and no scene divisions, rendered in modelled relief with feathered wings and fringed garment — quite different conventions and content.
